formulas.description: Formula to fetch the last day in upcoming month. Note that to get last date in a month, we go from 1st date in the month after and then subtracts 1 day. Result is the last date in prev month.
formulas.name: form_D_TodayPlus1Month

formulas.description: Formula to fetch the last day in 2 months from now. Note that to get last date in a month, we go from 1st date in the month after and then subtracts 1 day. Result is the last date in prev month.
formulas.name: form_D_TodayPlus2Months

formulas.description: Formula to fetch the last day in the month 3 months from now. Note that to get last date in a month, we go from 1st date in the month after and then subtracts 1 day. Result is the last date in prev month.
formulas.name: form_D_TodayPlus3Months
form_T_MonthYearCurrent
formulas.expression: CASE(MONTH(TODAY()), 1, '31 Januari', 2, '28 Februari', 3, '31 Mars', 4, '30 April', 5, '31 Maj', 6, '30 Juni', 7, '31 Juli', 8, '31 Augusti', 9, '30 September', 10, '31 Oktober', 11, '30 November', '31 December') &" "&TEXT(Year(TODAY())) &" "&"(Innevarande månad)"

formulas.name: form_T_MonthYearPlus1Month
formulas.expression: CASE(MONTH({!form_D_TodayPlus1Month}), 1, '31 Januari', 2, '28 Februari', 3, '31 Mars', 4, '30 April', 5, '31 Maj', 6, '30 Juni', 7, '31 Juli', 8, '31 Augusti', 9, '30 September', 10, '31 Oktober', 11, '30 November', '31 December') &" "&TEXT(Year({!form_D_TodayPlus1Month}))

formulas.name: form_T_MonthYearPlus2Months
formulas.expression: CASE(MONTH({!form_D_TodayPlus2Months}), 1, '31 Januari', 2, '28 Februari', 3, '31 Mars', 4, '30 April', 5, '31 Maj', 6, '30 Juni', 7, '31 Juli', 8, '31 Augusti', 9, '30 September', 10, '31 Oktober', 11, '30 November', '31 December') &" "&TEXT(Year({!form_D_TodayPlus2Months}))

formulas.name: form_T_MonthYearPlus3Months
formulas.expression: CASE(MONTH({!form_D_TodayPlus3Months}), 1, '31 Januari', 2, '28 Februari', 3, '31 Mars', 4, '30 April', 5, '31 Maj', 6, '30 Juni', 7, '31 Juli', 8, '31 Augusti', 9, '30 September', 10, '31 Oktober', 11, '30 November', '31 December') &" "&TEXT(Year({!form_D_TodayPlus3Months}))
